title: Company A Product X rollout call
contextText: Call with Jonty from Company A ahead of the pilot review of the Product X rollout; notes only.

note.body:
# Company A Product X rollout call

**Date:** October 6
**Attendees:** Mercer Stubbs, Jonty Fixture, Nell Mockwell

## Summary

I talked to Jonty from Company A about the Product X rollout at Company A. Jonty Fixture works for Company A, a regional insurer, and sits on the group that will decide whether the rollout goes ahead. Company A is piloting Product X with a single claims team, and the call was meant to hear where Jonty stands before the pilot review. The mood was constructive but careful.

## Where Jonty stands

Jonty is a stakeholder in the Product X rollout. He said he is skeptical about the Product X rollout, because the pilot users have not yet shown a time saving that justifies the price. He did not object to the pilot itself, only to widening it before the numbers are in. He asked for a plain comparison of hours saved against the cost per seat.

## The pilot and the product

Company A is piloting Product X with a single claims team of about twelve people. Product X is offered by Org Beta, and the pilot runs on the trial licences Org Beta granted for ninety days. The Product X rollout concerns Product X itself and the question of licensing cost. The claims team uses it mostly for drafting letters and summarising long case files.

## What is blocking

- The licence budget isn't approved, so the rollout cannot move past the pilot until finance signs it off. Jonty called it the first thing that has to be settled.
- Jonty expects the licensing cost to be the main subject of the next review, ahead of any question about quality.

## Other attendees

Nell Mockwell from the IT team at Company A joined for the last ten minutes and only took notes. She did not state a position on the rollout. Her team will help with the licence assignment if the budget is approved.

## Next steps

Mercer will send Jonty the pilot usage summary after the second month closes. The group meets again once the pilot review has taken place, and the summary of this call goes to the programme office.
